thread:
Lena: Quick thread to lock the June webinar format. thinking: topic = "making inference cheap & reliable in prod". want concrete playbooks, not research-y.
Kofi: Agree. audience = infra/platform PMs + ML engineers. goal: 3 adoptable tactics + one case study.
Priya: We should write 3 short abstracts (<= 60 words) that map to landing page variations. I can draft if we agree on themes.
Lena: Themes: 1) batching + cache patterns, 2) model variant routing + graceful degradation, 3) observability for cost-quality tradeoffs.
Jordan: AV / ops note: avoid live cluster changes. we'll do canned commands + recorded playback for anything that changes infra.
Maya: I'll run panelist ops. we need speaker one-pagers with TL;DR, 2 talking bullets, and a 90s demo script. no more than 1 page.
Kofi: Panelists: 2 internal (product + runtime eng), 1 customer (long-running pipelines), 1 partner (inference infra). who do we ask?
Lena: Internal: @Priya (product) + @Jordan (runtime). Customer: reach out to Amir at DataSteps. Partner: ask Olena at CloudGrid. Kofi can ping.
Kofi: Will DM Amir & Olena today.
Priya: Draft abstracts (first pass):
```
Abstract A: Batching & cache: reduce p95 by batching and prefix caching. short playbook + config snippets; demo: 2x speedup on conversational workload.
Abstract B: Model variant routing: route to smaller quantized model on burst/failure to preserve latency. demo: graceful fallback w/ no dropped requests.
Abstract C: Cost-quality telemetry: build SLOs from evals, alert on regression, tie to auto-rollout guardrails.
```
Jordan: Run-of-show suggestion (50m):
```
0:00-0:04 Host welcome + goals
0:04-0:18 Case study deep-dive (15m): customer story + results
0:18-0:30 Panel (12m): moderated Q from host
0:30-0:42 Tactical playbooks (3x4m lightning demos) 
0:42-0:47 Live audience Q (moderator filters)
0:47-0:50 CTAs + lead routing notes
```
Maya: Lightning demos = strict template: 30s setup, 90s demo playback, 60s recap. helps with editing and clips.
Priya: I'll convert the abstracts into 3 landing variants (A/B/C) and write suggested CTAs. propose CTAs: "Run a 10-min trial", "Get a cost review", "Schedule enterprise consult".
Lena: Lead routing: HubSpot lists -> trial (self-serve), demo-request (AE), enterprise (AE+Solutions). add source=webinar, tag=jun2026.
Kofi: Also capture field: infra_preference (hosted/dedicated/private). Maya, can you add hidden form fields?
Maya: Yup. will include region and infra_preference.
Jordan: Rehearsal plan: two dry runs: run-thru (no slides, 30m) + full dress (45m) recording on. schedule both 1 week and 2 days out. ops-bot: rehearsal windows recommended Mon/Tue mornings.
tech-bot: Auto-note: please upload fallback clips (mp4) to shared folder named /webinars/jun2026/backups. max length 2m each.
Priya: Marketing needs: 4 social hooks (X copy + LinkedIn), hero bench stat for ad creative, and 2 short demo gifs.
Lena: Who's owning bench stat? Kofi?
Kofi: I'll run micro-bench for batching vs baseline and share one headline stat (p95 down X%, cost down Y%) by EOD Friday.
Maya: Speaker logistics: send one-pager template + rehearsal checklist. speakers must confirm mic + webcam 48h before dress.
Lena: Also decide recording policy: allow repurposing for case studies + clips. include opt-in on speaker one-pager.
Priya: I'll draft speaker one-pager and share in drive. includes TL;DR, demo script, fallback recording link field, and opt-in checkbox.
Jordan: Final ask: provide editors with timecodes for each demo so they can produce 30s highlight clips quickly.
Lena: OK team, action items: Priya = landing variants + speaker one-pager; Kofi = guest outreach + bench stat; Jordan = AV playbook + demo timecodes template; Maya = rehearsal invites + hidden form fields. I'll assemble run-of-show draft and circulate.
Maya: Scheduling: calendar-bot created tentative events: full dress on 2026-06-08 16:00 UTC, run-thru on 2026-06-01 16:00 UTC.
Lena: Thanks all. short, prescriptive webinar will convert better. :sparkles:
